crossRefs.note: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

translations.web: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.
translations.bsb: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
translations.kjv: He will take the tenth of your sheep: and ye shall be his servants.
translations.asv: He will take the tenth of your flocks: and ye shall be his servants.
